svg.title: GEX Starter, Terminal and Market Wind Tunnel
svg.desc: Current local product boundaries, derived from docs/architecture.md. One starter opens Terminal, Market Wind Tunnel, Both, or registered Saved data — Both for ES or NQ. Saved startup verifies a complete local capture and prepares its final immutable checkpoint. Terminal loads the whole session; the Wind Tunnel local service opens the frozen final state in a browser. At load completion the source inputs match, but the processes and later selections stay independent. The browser compares default and directionalized proxies under price, IV and model-time changes. Health, pricing coverage and accepted-IV age are distinct. Explicit Terminal w handoff freezes another eligible demo/replay checkpoint into a Terminal-owned local service; it does not stream later state. Full receipts embed frozen inputs and retain calculation identity for reproduction. No provider connection is needed for these saved-data paths. This is an architecture diagram, not a product screenshot.
svg.text: GEX / TWO COMPONENTS / ONE LOCAL INSTALLATION
Load a saved session. Inspect a frozen market.
Terminal · Wind Tunnel · Both · Saved data — Both → ES or NQ
Textual UI inside its Python process
Stress price, IV and model time
Starter verifies capture + checkpoint identities; Terminal loads all events.
Inputs match after loading. Later replay, model and scenario choices do not synchronize.
Press w in eligible Terminal replay
Later events never alter the frozen input
Health, pricing coverage and IV age stay visible
Shared package and pricing code · local files · no provider requests
Saved-data workflow only. Live access and predictive validity require separate evidence.
